title: 第438章 改革开始第437章 说服
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
次日，长渊宗的命令下发到全部宗门。
天音堂内，祖师听到苏少卿上位第一件事将李默言押入大牢，又看到手中这一纸命书，笑了笑，随即便大手一挥。
“释玉，传我命令，褪下天音堂牌匾，按照长渊宗的命令即刻制造新匾。”
“是，师父。”
与此同时，云针门，幻影仙宗，甚至青岚阁也在同步推进，将原本的匾额拿下来，随后即刻制造新匾额。
唯独…………
嘭！
一张实木桌子在易水华的掌下化为粉末。
“许风，你这个懦夫！”
“师父，息怒啊师父，长渊宗此次连自己的名号也一并删去，我们的理由已经不攻自破了，现下我们只能先听从长渊宗的命令，之后再静观其变啊。”一名弟子跪在易水华脚下苦口婆心的劝道。
“变？哪还有变数，长渊宗现在自己都没了，我们要是还敢动手，那就是造反，更何况，我们一个盟友都没有。”易水华咬牙切齿的走下台阶，看着长渊宗的方向。
“哲，我隐水宗与你，势不两立！”易水华怒道。
“来人啊，将隐水宗牌匾撤下，按照长渊宗的命令即刻制造牌匾。”易水华说完，猛的一甩衣袖，随后离开大殿。
长渊宗。
长峰未必有仙气，渊深自有蛟龙来。
这两块刻着长渊宗精神的扁石，是苏少卿刚来到长渊宗时，第一眼看到的东西。
它承载着百年长渊立足的根本，多少长渊弟子是因为它，才加入的长渊宗，但此刻，它却就这样，静静的躺在地上。
谢广鹏慢慢的蹲下来，半跪在地上，用手轻轻的抚摸着那两块扁石。
“大长老。”
一双手轻轻的放到谢广鹏的肩膀上。

“宗主，我没事，只是时间长了，多少，也有了点感情。”谢广鹏站起身，看了看一旁立在地上的牌匾，那上面刻着的“长渊宗”三个字，直到现在，还散发着别样的光芒。
“大长老，对不起。”苏少卿心怀愧疚的看着谢广鹏。
他知道，若不是谢广鹏在大殿之上一直维护自己，自己没有那么容易说服几位长老。
谢广鹏，现在长渊宗内资历最老的人，跟着长渊宗走过了多少风风雨雨。
十八岁拜入长渊宗宗主，二十岁成为大师兄，二十八岁少宗主被害，宗主为报仇雪恨，身死道消，宗门险些覆灭。
整个宗门被自己一肩扛起，直到现在，三十多年过去了，谢广鹏将自己的一生都奉献给了长渊，没想到有一天，竟然是自己，亲手摘下了长渊宗的名号。
“宗主，您是对的，一切都是为了白夜谷。”谢广鹏轻声叹了口气。
“宗主，我能不能将这三块匾额收藏。”
“当然可以。”苏少卿点了点头。
“多谢宗主。”谢广鹏躬身行礼，随后将三块匾额收入玄戒，走回长渊宗内。
“唉。”苏少卿轻声叹了口气。
“宗主。”玄墨走上前，拍了拍苏少卿的肩膀。
“玄墨大哥，私底下不必如此，你我还是以兄弟相称。”苏少卿道。
“无规矩不成方圆，不能乱了身份。”玄墨道。
苏少卿闻言默默转过了身。
“玄墨，传我的命令，三日之后，召集各司司主，前来长渊大殿开会。”
天神域，中央神州，烈阳宗。
“你去看看。”
“我不去，你去吧，你懂她的心思。”
“她是不是你女儿，你就这么不关心啊。”

“我怕我说错话。”
“在外面天不怕地不怕的，现在你怕了，早干什么去了。”
…………
神晓云屋外，神安戈与安澜相互推辞着。
“我都不知道晓云经历了什么，我怎么劝啊。”神安戈神色为难道。
content_en:
The next day, the Changyuan Sect's order was sent to all sects.
In the Tianyin Hall, the Patriarch heard that the first thing Su Shaoqing did when he came to power was to take Li Moyan to prison. He also saw the life sheet in his hand, smiled, and then waved his hand.
"Shi Yu, pass on my order to take off the plaque of Tianyintang and make a new plaque immediately according to the order of Changyuan Sect."
"Yes, Master."
At the same time, Yunzhen Sect, Phantom Immortal Sect, and even Qinglan Pavilion are also advancing simultaneously, taking down the original plaques, and then immediately creating new plaques.
Only…………
Bang!
A solid wood table turned into powder under Yi Shuihua's palm.
"Xu Feng, you coward!"
"Master, please calm down. Master, Changyuan Sect has also deleted his own name this time. Our reason has been defeated. Now we can only obey the orders of Changyuan Sect first, and then wait and see what happens." A disciple knelt at Yi Shuihua's feet and advised earnestly.
"Change? There are no variables. The Changyuan Sect is gone now. If we still dare to take action, it will be a rebellion. What's more, we don't have any allies." Yi Shuihua gritted his teeth and walked down the steps, looking in the direction of the Changyuan Sect.
"Zhe, our Hidden Water Sect and you are at odds with each other!" Yi Shuihua said angrily.
"Come here, take down the Yinshui Sect plaque and make one immediately according to the Changyuan Sect's order." After Yi Shuihua finished speaking, he flicked his sleeves and left the hall.
Changyuan Sect.
Long peaks may not have immortality, but dragons will come from the depths of the abyss.
These two flat stones engraved with the spirit of Changyuan Sect were the first things Su Shaoqing saw when he first came to Changyuan Sect.
It carries the foundation of Changyuan for hundreds of years. Many Changyuan disciples joined the Changyuan Sect because of it. But at this moment, it is just like this, lying quietly on the ground.
Xie Guangpeng slowly squatted down, half-kneeling on the ground, and gently stroked the two flat stones with his hands.
"Great Elder."
A pair of hands gently placed on Xie Guangpeng's shoulders.
"Sect Master, I'm fine. It's just that it's been a long time, so I've developed some feelings." Xie Guangpeng stood up and looked at the plaque standing on the ground. The three words "Zhang Yuan Sect" engraved on it still exude a different kind of light until now.
"Great Elder, I'm sorry." Su Shaoqing looked at Xie Guangpeng guiltily.
He knew that if Xie Guangpeng had not always defended himself in the main hall, he would not have been able to convince the elders so easily.
Xie Guangpeng, now the oldest person in Changyuan Sect, has gone through many ups and downs with Changyuan Sect.
At the age of eighteen, he became the master of the Changyuan Sect and became the senior brother at the age of twenty. The young master was murdered at the age of twenty-eight. In order to avenge his death, the master died and the sect was almost destroyed.
The entire sect was carried on his shoulders. Until now, more than thirty years have passed. Xie Guangpeng has devoted his whole life to Changyuan. Unexpectedly, one day, he would be the one to take the title of Changyuan Sect with his own hands.
"Sect Master, you are right, everything is for Bai Ye Valley." Xie Guangpeng sighed softly.
"Sect Master, can I collect these three plaques?"
"Of course." Su Shaoqing nodded.
"Thank you, sect master." Xie Guangpeng bowed and saluted, then put the three plaques into the Xuan Ring and walked back to Changyuan Sect.
"Alas." Su Shaoqing sighed softly.
"Sect Master." Xuan Mo stepped forward and patted Su Shaoqing on the shoulder.
"Brother Xuanmo, you don't have to be like this in private, you and I should still treat each other as brothers." Su Shaoqing said.
"If there are no rules, there will be no rules. We cannot mess up our identity." Xuan Mo said.
Su Shaoqing turned around silently after hearing this.
"Xuan Mo, pass on my order. In three days, the heads of all departments will be summoned to the Changyuan Hall for a meeting."
Heavenly God Realm, Central China, Lieyang Sect.
"Go and have a look."
"I won't go, you go, you know what she's thinking."
"You don't care so much whether she is your daughter or not."
"I'm afraid I said the wrong thing."
"OutsideYou are not afraid of heaven and earth. Now that you are afraid, what have you done? "
…………
Outside Shen Xiaoyun's house, Shen Ange and An Lan were exchanging words.
"I don't even know what Xiaoyun has been through, how can I persuade him. "Shen An Ge looked confused.
